assumptions: Both modeled tasks remain continuously runnable until their third poll and self-wake after each of their first two polls.
The bounded explorer admits every six-poll schedule containing three polls of each task with no task selected more than twice consecutively.
Weak fairness requires eventual polling of continuously runnable work but does not define task order, equal CPU allocation, maximum latency, or timestamps.
This bounded corpus and its failure replays are not an unbounded proof over all Gantry programs, task graphs, or host schedules.

replay_cases.invariant: A confirmed stop prevents every later poll and a stale wake cannot make the task runnable or mutate task state.
One task panic maps to executor-failure without preventing an independent runnable sibling from settling.
A failed executor submission creates no executor-owned task and returns the exact structured executor failure.
